prompt: A photorealistic photo captures the bustling interior of a vintage train dining car. On the left, a woman in a blue dress sits on a velvet bench, holding a silver spoon over a white bowl. Next to her, a man in a gray suit leans forward, pointing at a folded newspaper resting on the polished wooden table. In the center, a waiter in a black vest stands upright, handing a glass of red wine to an elderly lady with pearl earrings. She reaches out with a gloved hand to accept the drink while looking at the waiter. A brown leather suitcase rests on the floor beside the elderly lady's feet. To the right, a young boy in a striped shirt stares intently at a chocolate cake placed before him. His mother, wearing a green hat, wipes his chin with a white napkin. Behind them, a conductor in a navy uniform checks a pocket watch hanging from his chain. A small potted fern sits on a shelf above the conductor's head. Near the window, a tourist in a yellow jacket looks out at the passing landscape, holding a camera with both hands. Beside the tourist, a sleeping cat with orange fur curls up on an empty seat cushion. A businessman in a tie types rapidly on a silver laptop positioned on the table in front of him. Across from the businessman, a student in a hoodie reads a thick textbook, ignoring the noise around her. A half-eaten apple lies on the student's plate. A couple shares a quiet moment; the man in a beige coat holds the hand of the woman in a pink scarf. They sit close together, their knees touching under the table. A brass lamp hangs from the ceiling directly above the couple, casting a warm glow. A stack of clean white plates is visible on a side cart near the kitchen door. There is no digital clock on the wall. There is no plastic cutlery anywhere in the scene. There is no smartphone visible in anyone's hand.
